title: Indev Oak Door
description: This resource pack just basically brings back the unused windowless Indev Doors. That's all there is sadly.
body:
# ![door of no windows and wonder](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2ed28256fd290324147771f1e56dacae7006745d.png) Introduction ![door of no windows and wonder](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2ed28256fd290324147771f1e56dacae7006745d.png)
This resource pack brings back the [unused Indev doors](https://tcrf.net/Minecraft:_Java_Edition/Unused_Graphics#Windowless_Door) back to life!

This project is just a simple restoration of that, with a bit of touching up.
 - - -
![preview of doors and no windows](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c817fb5344e34ef930a03fde726255737989ade3.png)
 - - -
I mean, thats all I need to say for now, so try it out!

![door of no windows and wonder (Electric Boogaloo)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/780387a6ef827ada8d008e6c3efbe84702094e5a_0.webp)

### Credits to Mojang Studios, and [The Cutting Room Floor](https://tcrf.net/The_Cutting_Room_Floor).
